verdict.rationale: Obsidian ships a developer plugin API (obsidian-api, a TypeScript plugin SDK), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents API versioning, version guarantees, or a deprecation policy. The pack only describes what the API exposes (e.g. the Vault interface) and how to build plugins.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
